entry_points.text: Create buffers, handle diagnostic dump and teardown, copy ranges, and access backplane by sized and block transfers.
Absent external interface, MIPS and PCI cores use safe fallbacks that do nothing or report absence without touching hardware.
Boot guard init does nothing here, per task reliable capture may report unsupported, socket pointer struct copy bridges user and kernel forms.

exports.text: Allocate packet buffers by size and context with clone, device, poll and page variants; pad linear area and release singly, by list or by consume.
Init queue head with lock, insert at head or tail or around a member, remove from ends, purge all, read length, peek head, manage refs by get, share check and unshare.
Init and validate checksums, convert and forward state, fold and store results; query and adjust offload segmentation, install route and hash, compute hash lazily.
Fallback policy allows tracing and permission checks, denies secure filesystem and drive security entry, succeeds memory attribute changes, forwards chipcommon register access when bound.
Copy between tagged socket pointers and local memory with length checks, copy file ranges through splice, handle variadic lists via compiler helpers, refresh stack guard and capture stacks.

hazards.text: Size steps span small to huge powers with multiples; checksum has four modes with limited nesting; alignment uses cache line, true size adds overhead, fragment count is bounded.

Families cover a bounded range with protocol aliases, backlog is bounded, message flags include control and zero copy bits with compatibility and internal masks, levels cover common protocols, splice uses move and more hints, ancillary types carry rights and identity.

One chip swaps clock availability bits; some flash opcodes are undefined and offsets need signed math; write enable gates updates; fabric status must be checked for reset, reject, busy, timeout and test failure before trust.

Bad push or alignment, misuse on paged buffers and failed trim are fatal; orphan clears ownership; fragment address may be absent; scattered large offload warns; head lock state follows fragment and clone state; missing capture is not success.

invariants.text: Empty queue is self linked with zero length; insert and unlink adjust links and count; splice joins nonempty source or leaves target unchanged.
Headers are offsets from buffer start with reset at data and set by adding; unset uses all ones; paged length implies nonlinear; trim clears completed checksum.

Extensions use presence mask with fixed unit offsets, delete only present entries, share on copy; security mark copies or clears; transmit queue set directly, receive queue uses offset encoding with zero meaning none.

Ancillary data uses word alignment with distinct space and length, first header needs coverage, iteration ends with null; teardown maps selected families to groups; sequence overflow clamps used length and reports empty remainder.

Presence and revision predicates select storage and feature paths; clock and voltage selectors are ordered; availability equals bound link except absent cores false; member offset plus size yields past end.

locks.text: Queue head lock guards enqueue and dequeue; unowned route and lockless empty or tail reads require read side protection.
Backplane switch lock guards segment and core selection plus legacy MMIO; each GPIO bank has its own lock; cookie generation is wrapped by scheduler protection.

state_machines.text: Reserve headroom then move data start by push or pull, set linear length, extend tail by growth and shrink by trim.
Checksum moves among none, complete and partial; complete validates or stores, none may promote on valid input, partial carries start and extent, forward demotes, push or pull adjust stored value.
Clocks progress from idle to active to high throughput by request then poll; higher availability implies lower usable; hardware may self manage unless forced.

structs.text: Packet carrier with links, device, lengths, flags and header offsets, plus clone pair, fragment descriptors, fragment list, shared info with frags and offload state, zerocopy completion and extension table.

Socket addresses in fixed, flexible and largest forms with family and linger; kernel and user message headers with address, scatter, control and flags; credential triple; tagged pointer; splice progress and pipe descriptors.
Backplane device with ops and identifiers, driver with match and callbacks, bus with mappings, locks, chip, cores and board data, plus PROM, board info, chipcommon, serial and PCI core records.

Fabric map with per core window and enumeration span, target and initiator state, identification low and high, interrupt vector and routing, address match descriptors, BAR windows and PROM geometry with revision and checksum.

Power unit control with enables and status availability, chip identification, watchdog clock with ceiling, GPIO windows by index, sequence buffer with capacity and length, trace carrier with count and skip, null pointer and boolean values.
